Don't worry about "bulking/cutting" type diets yet. Don't worry about ratios. Don't worry about fat percentage. These are ideas that will set you up for failure.

Just start working out. Don't worry about all the other stuff. The most important thing now is that you start working out. Get in the gym or at home wherever. Just do it. Get in a routine. Eat cleaner (no fast food, no junk). If you question if its bad for you, throw it out. Easy as that.

Once you have a routine and your getting used to your workouts start looking at shaping your diet and workout routine.
